name: Sind
raw_line: (3) If a Judge of a High Court, who is a member of the Indian Civil Service, is permitted to retire before completing 6\frac{1}{2} years' service for pension in a High Court, but after completing that period of service in a High Court and a Chief Court combined, or in a High Court and one of the Judicial Commissioner's Courts of Oudh, Sind, or the Central Provinces or as Judicial Commissioner, or as officiating Judicial Commissioner of Upper Burma combined, he shall receive, in addition to the pension for which he is eligible under the ordinary rules relating to that Service, a pension of £100 divided by 6\frac{1}{2} for each completed year of service for pension as a Judge of a High Court. Provided that no Judge shall receive an additional pension calculated in accordance with this rule who has not attained the age of 60 years, unless he either retires on medical certificate or has had a service for pension of at least 11\frac{1}{2} years in a High Court and Chief Court combined, or in a High Court and a Judicial Commissioner's Court combined.

name: Climatic conditions are extremely diversified
raw_line: Meteorology. —Climatic conditions are extremely diversified, the Dera Ismail Khan District being one of the hottest areas in India, while in the northern mountain region the weather is temperate in summer and intensely cold in winter. The air is generally dry and the daily and annual ranges of temperature are frequently very large. There are two wet seasons: one the monsoon, the other in winter when storms from Mesopotamia, Persia and the Caspian districts bring widespread rain and snowfall. Both sources of supply are precarious, and not infrequently one of them fails. The lightest annual rainfall is that of Dera Ismail Khan (9 inches), the heaviest that of Hazara, Abbottabad having a rainfall of 46 inches. The temperature in Dera Ismail Khan rises during the hottest part of the year to between 113^{\circ} and 118^{\circ} ; in Peshawar it is between 113^{\circ} and 119^{\circ} . In the cold weather it is about 55^{\circ} at Peshawar, and 58^{\circ} at Dera Ismail Khan.

raw_line: BURN, SIDNEY, Indian C.S. ( dist. and sessions judge, Madras ) (b. 19th June, 1881).—Educ. at Wakefield Gr. raw_line: CAROE, OLAF KIRKPATRICK, M.A. (Oxon), Indian C.S. ( pol. officer ) (b. 15th Nov., 1892).—Educ. at Winchester and Magdalen Coll., Oxford; joined the service, 31st Aug., 1920; arrived, 4th Dec., 1920, and served in the Punjab as asst. commr.; city mag., Peshawar, Nov., 1923; dep. commr., Peshawar, April, 1926; asst. dep. commr., Mardan, Oct., 1926; dep. commr., Hazara, Aug., 1927; ditto, Kohat, Nov., 1928.

name: CARR, WILLIAM
raw_line: CARR, WILLIAM, Indian C.S. ( judge, high ct., Rangoon ) (b. 9th Feb., 1872).—Educ. at Lancaster Gr. Sch., and Christ's Coll., Cambridge; apptd. after exam. of 1891; arrived, 14th Nov., 1893, and served in Burma as asst. commr.; judge, small cause court, Mandalay, Feb., 1905; also dist. judge, March, 1905; divl. judge, 1909; addl. judge, high ct., Rangoon, Jan., 1923; judge, high ct., Rangoon, July, 1924.

name: CATER, ALEXANDER NORMAN LEY
raw_line: CATER, ALEXANDER NORMAN LEY, C.I.E. , Indian C.S. ( pol. officer ) (b. 15th June, 1880).—Educ. at Wellington Coll. and Christ's Coll., Cambridge; apptd. after exam. of 1903; arrived, 5th Dec., 1904, and served in the Punjab as asst. commr.; personal asst. to pol. agent, Phulkiani States and Bahawalpur, April, 1907; pol. asst., Baluchistan, Jan., 1909; asst. pol. agent, Sibi, Nov., 1909; asst. agent to govr.-gen., Baluchistan, Oct., 1910; asst. pol. agent, Zhob, Sept., 1911; asst. to agent to govr.-gen., Baluchistan, Sept., 1914; asst. pol. agent, Kalat, Oct., 1914; second asst. to agent to govr.-gen., in Baluchistan, Oct., 1915; first asst. to ditto, Jan., 1916; first asst. resdnt., Hyderabad, March, 1917; offg. dep. sec. (foreign) , for. and pol. dept., govt. of India, April, 1919; confd., Oct., 1919 ; sec. to resdnt. in Mysore, Feb., 1923; resident at Jaipur, Nov., 1925; also addl. charge of office of pol. agent, Haraoti and Tonk from April, 1926; resdnt., Jaipur, Sept., 1928; offg. agent to govr.-genl. in Rajputand and C.C., Ajiner, Merwara Apl., 1929 ; C.I.E., Jan., 1930.

name: HUGH EDWARD
raw_line: CLERK, HUGH EDWARD, C.I.E., late Madras Public Works Dept.—Trained at R.I.E. Coll.; apptd. asst. engr., Sept., 1880; exec. engr., Aug., 1893; suptg. engr., Oct., 1905; chief engr., and joint sec., P.W.D., Madras, May, 1911; C.I.E., Jan., 1914; ret'd., June, 1914.

name: COLDSTREAM, JOHN
raw_line: COLDSTREAM, JOHN, B.A., Indian C.S. ( judge, high ct., Lahore ) (b. 23rd Dec., 1877).—Educ. at Edinburgh Acad. and Worcester Coll., Oxford; apptd. after exam. of 1900; arrived, 19th Nov., 1901, and served in the Punjab as asst. commr.; under-sec. to govt., Oct., 1906, to Feb., 1910; asst. commr. and settlt. offr., April, 1910; temply. employed under War Office from Oct., 1914, to July, 1916; dep. commr., Oct., 1917; dist. and sess. judge, Aug., 1918; legal remembrancer and sec. to govt. of Punjab, legisl. dept., Oct., 1923; actg. judge, high ct., Lahore, May to July, 1925; ditto, April to July, 1926; addl. judge, ditto, Oct., 1926; judge, ditto, Sept., 1928.

name: MASTER, ALFRED
raw_line: MASTER, ALFRED, B.A., Indian C.S. (collr. and dist. mag., Bombay) (b. 12th Feb., 1883).—Educ. at Epsom Coll., and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; apptd. after exam. of 1905; arrived, 10th Dec., 1906, and served in Bombay as asst. collr. and mag., and asst. settlt. offr.; munpl. commr., Ahmedabad, Aug., 1917; on mil. duty, Sept., 1918, to Aug., 1919; settlement officer, Nov., 1922; jt. sec. to govt., gen., educ. and marine depts., July, 1925; offg. sec. to ditto, Sept., 1925; member of legisl. council, Oct., 1925; offg. collr. and dist. mag. and pol. agent, April, 1926; confd., Oct., 1926.

name: Moseley, Archie Gerard
raw_line: MOSELY, ARCHIE GERARD, Indian C.S. ( judge, high ct., Rangoon ) (b. 6th March, 1883).—Educ. at Clifton, and Wadham Coll., Oxford; apptd. after exam. of 1906; arrived, 19th Dec., 1907, and served in Burma as asst. commr.; dep. commr. (prov.), June, 1918; dist. and sess. judge, Jan., 1923; judge, high ct., Rangoon, July, 1929.

name: MOWBRAY, ROBERT
raw_line: MOWBRAY, ROBERT, M.A., India Office ( principal, finl. dept. ) (b. 31st Mar., 1877).—Educ. at Manchester Gr. Sch., and Brasenose Coll., Oxford (scholar, 1896-1900; Green Prize, 1905); apptd. junr. clerk, acctnt.-gen.'s dept., India Office, 29th Oct., 1900; joint editor of India Office List, Nov., 1907, to July, 1913; assessor of income tax, March, 1910, to June, 1917; senr. clerk, July, 1913; clerk to the commrs. of income tax, Oct., 1920; principal, April, 1921; actg. dep. clerk of Council, 1st Dec., 1928.

name: MUKHARJI, DEBABRATA
raw_line: MUKHARJI, DEBABRATA , B.L., Judicial Dept., Bengal ( sub-judge ) (b. 18th Feb., 1875).—Joined the service as munsif, 4th Aug., 1900; sub-judge, Oct., 1919.
